That is what it was built for. Client meetings, 1:1s, interviews, lectures, site visits. Phone on the table, one tap, and you can stop writing and start listening.

CAN ECHO RECORD ZOOM, TEAMS, AND GOOGLE MEET CALLS?

Yes, and any other call too. Echo records from your iPhone the same way it records a conversation in the room, so the platform does not matter and there is nothing to connect.

The full transcript, a summary of what was discussed, the key points, and the action items. Enough to write the follow up email without opening the recording again.

And when you need one specific thing out of an old meeting, just ask. Echo AI searches the recording for you: what the client agreed to, when the deadline is, who owns what.

record.name: Paxo: AI Meeting Notes
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Paxo is purpose-built for in-person conversations. Stop letting key decisions and action items fall through the cracks. Simply hit record and let Paxo do the rest.

Paxo offers tons of groundbreaking features:

- AI-Generated, fully editable markdown notes: After recording a meeting, Paxo leverages OpenAI GPT to automatically generate notes in a well-summarized, easy-to-digest format that comprehensively covers the contents of your meeting. These notes are fully editable, and they can be exported to your document-editor of choice (Notion, Google Docs, Microsoft Word, etc.)

- Speaker identification: Paxo uses cutting-edge voice processing to distinguish between speakers in your meetings. Conveniently assign speakers using your Contacts, and Paxo will learn their voices and recommend speaker assignments for future recordings. After assigning speakers, the transcript and notes will update in real-time to reflect speaker names.

- Automatic time-indexed transcripts: In addition to markdown notes, Paxo uses state-of-the-art OpenAI Whisper technology to generate a transcript of the audio. This transcript is fully interactive; you can click on a part of the transcript to seek to a different point in the audio playback, and the part of the transcript that is highlighted tracks what is being played by the audio player.

- Audio playback: The underlying audio recording is saved and playable from within the interface, with support for seeking to different points in the recording, skipping back and forth 10 seconds, and changing playback speed.

- Search: All your notes on Paxo are fully searchable; you can search for a piece of text that appeared in your notes or transcript for a recording. Searching yields a list of recordings and previews for the search text, from where you can click on the desired recording.

- Import and export: Paxo makes it easy to import and export recordings, transcripts, and notes, so you can use them with other applications. Export your recordings, transcripts, and notes in .txt and .m4a formats. You can even choose to directly import a recording from another app (Google Drive, Dropbox, etc.) into Paxo.

PLANS AND PRICING

AI-generated notes and speaker identification are only available if you subscribe to Paxo Pro for $8.99 / month. Transcriptions are available for all users free of charge.

PRIVACY AND SECURITY

Paxo is architected from the ground up for privacy. We store your recordings on device — not in our cloud. We delete your recordings from our servers as soon as we're done processing them.

Contact Us: team@paxo.ai.

Privacy Policy and Terms of Service: https://www.paxo.ai/pages/terms-and-privacy

Never Take Notes Again.
CraftNote: Your AI Assistant for Effortless Note-Taking & Meeting Transcripts
Stay focused on the conversation — let CraftNote handle the rest.
Just say "take notes for me" and CraftNote does the rest.

CraftNote is the AI note taker that handles seamless note-taking, real-time transcription, and concise meeting summaries. Designed to keep up with the pace of modern work, it helps you capture every key moment without lifting a pen.

Whether you're leading a high-stakes business meeting, participating in a team brainstorm, or collecting your personal thoughts, CraftNote ensures nothing slips through the cracks.

Works Wherever You Do
Use CraftNote on iPhone, iPad, your laptop, and the web — your notes sync instantly across every device. Start a recording on your phone and pick it up in your browser without missing a beat.

Joins Your Meetings for You
CraftNote works alongside Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Slack Huddles, Webex, and more. Keep it open during a call, or send the CraftNote bot directly into the meeting to capture and summarize everything — even when you can't attend.

Built for Business, Designed for Everyone
CraftNote is built with professionals in mind — executives, consultants, managers, and remote teams — but this AI note taker is just as perfect for students, content creators, and anyone who wants to stay organized without the manual effort.
Wherever ideas happen, CraftNote is ready to listen, transcribe, and summarize.

Key Features

AI-Powered Meeting Summaries
Receive clean, structured summaries in seconds — ideal for follow-ups, action items, and sharing with your team.

Meeting Bot for Every Platform
Send CraftNote into your Zoom, Google Meet, or Teams calls and get a full transcript and summary automatically — no need to take notes or even be there.

Web App, No Download Needed
Record, transcribe, and summarize right from your browser at craftnote.com — everything stays in sync with your phone and tablet.

Works with all inputs
You can create smart notes from PDFs, video, audio, podcast, YouTube, phone calls, images, and more!

Real-Time Transcription
Capture conversations live or from audio recordings, with accurate multi-speaker detection.

Smart Organization
As your AI note taker, CraftNote automatically sorts, tags, and makes your notes searchable — so you can find exactly what you need, instantly.

Secure & Private
We take your privacy seriously. Your data is encrypted and you stay in control at all times.

Work Smarter, Not Harder
With CraftNote, you can stay engaged and contribute more — no more distractions from manual note-taking. Let your AI note taker do the heavy lifting while you focus on decisions, collaboration, and strategy.

Try CraftNote today — and experience note-taking, reimagined.

For support, contact us at: support@craftnote.com

Subscriptions
Pro features are available via auto-renewable subscription. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged within 24 hours of renewal. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime via your iTunes account settings.

• Summarize meetings, classes, and discussions easily from your notes

• Streamlined writing: Find notes from your connected accounts in one place to easily create, find, & act on your notes. Now with Samsung Notes integration.

• Smart notes: Capture smart notes in ink. Click the pen button & write down thoughts

record.description_evidence:
Put your phone on the table. Record the whole meeting. Get back a transcript, a summary, the decisions that got made, and a checklist of who owes what.

reScribe is built for meetings you're actually in — the doctor's appointment, the client call across the table, the lecture, the interview. It works just as well on a video call: put it on speaker and let reScribe listen. No bots joining your meeting, no plugins, nothing to configure.

TRY IT — NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
Try a real 15-minute recording before you sign up — transcript, summary, everything. Like it? Create an account and keep it.

NO TIME LIMITS
Record for ten minutes or three hours. reScribe doesn't cap recording length. It keeps going with your screen locked and your phone in your pocket, and if a call interrupts it, it picks back up on its own and tells you if anything was missed.

SEE IT ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
Check on a recording without opening the app — elapsed time and status show right on your Lock Screen.

NOTES, NOT JUST A TRANSCRIPT
Every recording comes back with a word-for-word transcript and a real summary: the gist, the key points, the decisions that got made, and the action items — with an owner and a due date. Every action item lands in a Tasks tab so nothing gets lost.

WHO SAID WHAT
reScribe separates speakers and labels them, then suggests names it heard for you to confirm. Tap a speaker's circle to reassign a turn, or split a turn where two people got merged.

ASK YOUR MEETINGS QUESTIONS
"What did I agree to?" Ask any recording a question and get an answer drawn only from what was actually said, with tappable timestamps to hear it yourself.

AI GETS THINGS WRONG. FIX IT IN TWO TAPS.
No transcription is perfect. Tap any line to fix it — a misheard name, a wrong decision, a garbled sentence. Play the audio while you read, and tap a timestamp to jump right there.

MANY LANGUAGES
Record in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Hindi, and more. Record in one language, get your summary in another.

DON'T FORGET THE NEXT ONE
Schedule an upcoming meeting and reScribe reminds you before it starts. Tap the reminder and the app opens ready to record.

TAKE IT WITH YOU
Export a clean PDF with only the sections you want. Copy everything as Markdown. Save the audio file itself.

PRIVACY
reScribe never joins a call, never announces itself to a room, and never emails your transcript to anyone. You hold the phone; you decide what gets recorded.

Your audio goes to a single transcription provider, who deletes it within 24 to 48 hours and doesn't use it to train anything. Only the text of your transcript is used to write your summary. We don't run ads, we don't track you, and we don't sell your data. Delete your account and everything goes with it.

WHAT ELSE
- Import audio you already have — voice messages, exported calls, anything
- Search across every transcript you've ever made
- Tag meetings and filter by tag
- Light and dark themes
- Face ID to keep your recordings private

SUBSCRIPTION
reScribe requires a subscription, with a 7-day free trial. Pro is monthly or yearly; Lite is monthly only — see In-App Purchases for pricing. Pro includes 30 hours of transcription a month; Lite includes 4. Go over, and recording still works — audio is saved, transcription resumes next month.

A NOTE ON ACCURACY
reScribe uses AI, and AI makes mistakes — misheard words, mixed-up speakers, missed quiet voices. Check anything important against the recording. reScribe gives you the tools to fix what it gets wrong, but don't rely on it for medical, legal, or financial decisions without verifying it yourself.

Recording laws vary by state and country. Some require everyone's consent. Know the rules where you are.

record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Whether you're meeting in person or on a video call, MoosePad captures every point and action item so you can put your pen down and stay in the conversation. Transcription runs on your device. Your audio is never sent to our AI service. It turns your meetings into organized, searchable notes on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. On Mac, it can capture system audio from Zoom, Teams, and your browser, not just your microphone. Hit record for a real-time transcript, then one tap generates a structured AI summary with key points, action items, and takeaways. Only text from the transcript and your notes is sent to our AI service for that summary.

You can also import audio you recorded somewhere else (podcasts, lectures, voice memos) and run it through the same transcription and summary flow.

PERFECT FOR

• Business meetings and team standups
• Church services and Bible studies
• University lectures and seminars
• Interviews and consultations
• Podcasts and voice memos

KEY FEATURES

• Real-time, on-device transcription using Apple's Speech framework
• AI summaries with sections, action items, and key takeaways
• Ask this meeting: chat with your notes
• Disable emojis in AI summaries from Settings
• Automatic, on-device speaker labels while recording, with names you can edit
• Detect speakers in saved notes when their audio is available
• Capture more than your microphone. On Mac, MoosePad records system audio directly from Zoom, Teams, browsers, and other apps. On iPhone and iPad, put a video call on speakerphone and MoosePad captures both sides through the mic. For direct Zoom or Teams system-audio capture, record on your Mac. (iOS doesn't let any app capture another app's call audio, or regular phone and FaceTime calls.)
• Personal notes with timestamps inside the transcript, including existing notes; adjustable transcript size while recording
• Import M4A, WAV, and MP3 files for transcription and summarization
• Select and copy any text from summaries, transcripts, and notes
• Edit transcripts, summaries, and notes after the fact, and find text within a note
• Organize meetings into folders and search by title or content
• iCloud sync across iPhone, iPad, and Mac
• Light and dark mode
• Live Activity and Dynamic Island support on iPhone
• Up to 8 hours of continuous recording
• 15+ languages for live transcription, 25+ for AI summaries

PRIVACY

Transcription and speaker detection run on your device. AI summaries send only text from your transcript and notes to our cloud AI service, never audio. Optional iCloud sync stores recordings and notes in your iCloud account.

On iPhone and iPad you can also start a system screen broadcast so MoosePad can transcribe audio that other apps make available, such as media playing back. iOS does not share live call audio (Zoom, Teams, Meet, phone, or FaceTime) with any app, so to capture a call put it on speakerphone or use MoosePad on Mac, which captures that system audio directly. iOS shows a standard screen-broadcast warning about screen content and notifications, but MoosePad only uses the audio. Screen content, notifications, and video are never captured or stored. The audio is written to a local container on your device, transcribed on device, and discarded when the broadcast ends.

LANGUAGES

Live transcription is available in English (US and UK), Spanish (Spain and Mexico), French, German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified and Cantonese), Arabic, and Turkish. AI summaries are also available in Portuguese (Portugal), Dutch, Hindi, Polish, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, Thai, and Indonesian.

ACROSS YOUR APPLE DEVICES

One subscription covers iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Your meetings sync through iCloud, so you can record on your phone and review on your Mac.

PRICING

• 7-day free trial
• $4.99/month or $49.99/year
• Family Sharing supported
